purpose: Reachability/discovery receipt for the voice catalog fixes; not certification of complete recorded-audio coverage.

confirmedReminderPolicy.scope: Only the eleven listed live, repeatable station reminder actor/text pairs. No general expansion of inherited t to all understudies.
confirmedReminderPolicy.rawWordSource: The shipped reminder's t; Cast.text returns u when non-null, otherwise t.
confirmedReminderPolicy.runtimeCaller: js/screens/encounter.js selects n.reminder on a revisited encounter and calls Rift.Dialogue.play(lead, ctx) without replay.
confirmedReminderPolicy.runtimeSpeaker: js/ui/dialogue.js resolves Cast.actor(role) and requests Rift.voiceId(actor, Cast.text(step, actor)).
confirmedReminderPolicy.test: tools/test/voice-coverage.test.mjs: eleven proven inherited reminders use their real encounter caller and retain original voice IDs

commonKukuWitness.path: Lose the Sundial at the Ch3 trial, enter Ch4, and visit the Stairwell/Evidence Locker arrival in ch4.landing; revisit the listed station.

tallyWitness.path: Meet Sequins at ch1.well, leave before winning the Well, lose him at the Gate, play his Quiet Scene after entering a later chapter, visit the Pattern Stall for his arrival, and revisit the unfinished Well.

addedPairs.text: Still shouting. Check the claims, not the volume.
Upstream, a rocket sits in the river. Muskrat calls it a reef now.
The well still wants evidence. Wishes just bounce off.
Still no sequence. Evidence, please. Not wishes.
The stone is still sure of itself. Test it.
The cage is empty. The crack has stopped drinking.
The charts hang a little crooked now. Check the axes anyway.
The machine still counts. It just doesn't boast.
His chalk is still here. Guess, pick the facts, finish the question.
His stamp is still on the desk. Check who the machine says no to.
The core is quiet. Its three old tricks still run, if you want them.

confirmedReminderPolicy.recordingQueue: These eleven pairs were discovered after the active generation process snapshotted the 2963-line catalog. All eleven lacked recordings at receipt capture and remain queued for a later natural pass.

inheritedTextAudit.definition: Distinct absent-or-null-u understudy/text IDs not already in the catalog. Empty u is excluded. This syntactic scan is not a count of reachable missing speech.

afterProvenReminderFix.reasonCountIsNotCertified: Caller conditions, first-visit and seen flags, saved replay cast, pre-line state changes and clock lifecycle can exclude further pairs. No broad set was added or sent to TTS.

inheritedTextAudit.safeNextPolicy: Prove additional actor/text pairs with the real caller and reachable post-arrival save states before adding them. Preserve explicit u:'' silence and original-only replay/death speech. Do not use raw candidate totals as a render queue.

tutorialHostInventory.scope: Conservative resolver-compatible flag inventory, not a proof that every sampled state is normal-play reachable.
handled: Fallback target actor selection without recursive fallback
tutorialHostInventory.hypotheticalArrivalIncluded: Rubberstamp can resolve under arrived:pip flags, but the shipped story never sets that arrival. design/UNDERSTUDIES.md deliberately specifies art/audition only for him. His conservatively inventoried tutorial recordings do not establish normal-play reachability.
tutorialHostInventory.futureConditionGuard: The inventory throws if a future tutorial-host condition uses clock danger until sampling for that condition is implemented.

finiteSideStoryFunctions.finding: Lucky Well generates clue-card text/table cells. Muskrat's Launch generates clue-card text and note-only steps, including its right-answer note. These are display-only.

checked.finding: Raw say/text pairs match existing catalog IDs. Canonical conversations use script lines and share the inherited-text reachability caveat.
Static lesson steps, hints, traps, replies and outro are covered; generated power explanations use all finite allowed avatar configurations. Creature barks come from inventoried data/barks.js.
Catch taunts use inventoried creature lines. Tutorial instructions use puzzle tutorial definitions.
Helpers named speak/api.say update displayed bubbles/text; they do not call Audio.speak and were not promoted into spoken inventory.

runtimeCompletion.reason: Recorded files and their content/boundaries require separate verification; unresolved inherited wording remains; runtime still invokes browser synthesis for missing/failed audio.
